item.title: From 52% to 100%: Measuring a Go Client Against the Proxmox API Schema
item.description: For five years the honest answer to “how much of the Proxmox API does go-proxmox cover?” was “a lot of it? the parts people asked for?”. Issues would come in for endpoints that didn’t exist in the client. I’d have no idea how many more were missing. At the end of May I finally built the thing that answers the question. Three days after the first run the answer was 100%. The more interesting part is how many times the measuring stick was wrong on the way there.
